alex: Pushed v2.11.0-canary to pool-phi at 11:02 UTC. Kicking off quick smoke: kv-prefill, http-heartbeat, embed-synth. tagging @deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: started smoke-suite (canary-small). probes: kv-prefill, http-heartbeat, embed-synth. ETA ~2m.

samira: acceptance: fail if embed-synth p95 > 240ms OR 5xx > 0.5% OR kv-prefill p95 > 100ms.

sre-oncall: noticing embed-synth p95 spike in pool-phi (regional) to ~305ms and 5xx ~1.0%. no obvious network errors. raising INC-2026-820.

deploy-bot: smoke-suite results:
- kv-prefill: OK (p95 35ms)
- http-heartbeat: OK
- embed-synth: FAIL (pool-phi) p95=305ms, 5xx=1.0%
Marking canary: PARTIAL_FAIL (pool-phi).

emma: prefer targeted rollback for pool-phi only. avoid global rollback since other pools green. Also capture quant/profile dump and kernel selection logs for the failing hosts.

alex: Agreed. Commanding targeted rollback + pin for pool-phi to previous stable v2.10.3.

/command
/deploy rollback inference --region pool-phi --to-version v2.10.3 --reason "embed-synth tail spike"
/deploy pin inference --region pool-phi --to-version v2.10.3 --reason "pin after regression"
deploy-bot: Targeted rollback + pin initiated by alex at 11:04 UTC. Rolling back pool-phi -> v2.10.3. ETA ~50s. Will auto-run post-rollback embed-synth extended (5m) in pool-phi.

sre-oncall: INC-2026-820 created and collecting traces, tokenizer and quant profile dumps, kernel-selection logs.

deploy-bot: Post-rollback embed-synth (pool-phi): p95=48ms, 5xx=0.0%. pool-phi: PASS. Global quick smoke re-run: all probes OK. Canary overall: PASS (pool-phi pinned to v2.10.3).

samira: Next steps: 1) reproduce locally with v2.11.0 quant/profile, 2) run extended synth sweep on staging, 3) add temporary alert: embed-synth p95 delta > 100ms within 5m. I'll add a short line to release notes: "Targeted rollback in pool-phi after embed-synth regression; investigating quant/kernel interaction."

emma: I'll own the repro attempt and attach traces to the release ticket. Leaving thread open for artifacts. :white_check_mark:
